semiconductor_relevance: Medium — MantiSpectra develops spectral sensing components that can be integrated into semiconductor-based products, but it is not primarily a semiconductor supplier.
summary: MantiSpectra specializes in advanced spectral sensing technology, focusing on the design and manufacture of solid-state hyperspectral sensor chips. Their products enable real-time, non-destructive analysis for both consumer and industrial applications, supporting data-driven decision-making.

regional_presence.Netherlands: MantiSpectra is based in Eindhoven, Netherlands, where it designs and manufactures its sensing technology.
